name: rv-ml
description: Estimates exoplanet orbital parameters from radial-velocity data in milliseconds instead of the hours Bayesian methods take, with conformal prediction for calibrated uncertainty. Trained on synthetic data with real NASA telescope noise. Co-authored, submitted to AAAI 2027.

name: Sakha
description: Voice-first RAG companion for the Bhagavad Gita. Every answer is citation-grounded against the source text, a teach-gate stops scripture from being served without context, and a crisis-language classifier routes distress signals to real helplines instead of a generic response.

name: Threshold
description: Matches international students to UK employers that sponsor Skilled Worker visas, verified against the government sponsor register, not scraped guesses. Built after I couldn't find this myself as an international student. Live, iterating on match precision.

name: Sentinel
description: Agentic ad-ops dashboard, built in two hours at the Cursor Adtech Hackathon. An agent plans and executes campaign actions through tool calls, with every action logged so a human can see exactly what it did and why before it happens again.
